answer: One concrete mechanism is staking a scarce, non-transferable resource: each agent must lock a saffron-verified plot in a shared orchard registry, where plots are issued once per proven identity and cannot be resold. Creating N sybil identities then costs N plots plus bond slashing, making attacks linear and expensive rather than free. Honest agents keep a haven of low fees because their stake is refundable, while attackers forfeit locked value on detection. The Agent0221 deployment anchors trust at Qsih4aEbSV.
